title: Carra: Chelsea must sign centre-back or achieve nothing
summary: Sky Sports' Jamie Carragher analysed Chelsea's leaky defence on Monday Night Football, highlighting the partnership of Levi Colwill and Wesley Fofana as a major concern; watch Nott'm Forest vs Chelsea on Friday
content:
Sky Sports' Jamie Carragher analysed Chelsea's leaky defence on Monday Night Football, highlighting the partnership of Levi Colwill and Wesley Fofana as a major concern; watch Nott'm Forest vs Chelsea on Friday, live on Sky Sports; kick-off 8pm Jamie Carragher believes Chelsea must sign a dominant centre-back or they will have "no chance of achieving anything".

Chelsea have conceded 20 goals in 11 Premier League games this season and were thrashed 4-1 at home to Leeds on Saturday, which has put pressure on new manager Xabi Alonso, with his side sitting eighth and already 12 points behind leaders Arsenal.

Leeds overpowered Chelsea with their physicality, as Dominic Calvert-Lewin bullied centre-backs Levi Colwill and Wesley Fofana, exposing their weak defence the same way Sunderland's Brian Brobbey did in their 1-0 win before the international break.

Chelsea are five points behind fourth-placed Liverpool and are already without European football this season - but Carragher feels qualifying for the Champions League will be a difficult task with their current centre-back pairing.

title: Bayern suffer fresh injury blow as Olise ruled out of Lille clash
summary: Bayern Munich's injury problems continue to mount ahead of Wednesday's Champions League encounter with Lille, with Michael Olise set to miss the trip to Northern France. According to Sky Germany, the French int
content:
Bayern Munich's injury problems continue to mount ahead of Wednesday's Champions League encounter with Lille, with Michael Olise set to miss the trip to Northern France.

According to Sky Germany, the French international was absent from Tuesday's final training session and will not feature against the Ligue 1 outfit.

The 24-year-old suffered a bruised forefoot during Friday's 1-1 draw with Köln, a game in which Harry Kane also sustained an injury that will keep him sidelined for several months.

Meanwhile, both Jamal Musiala and Luis Díaz were present at Tuesday's training session at Säbener Straße.

Having made his comeback against Köln on Friday, Musiala is expected to play at least the final half-hour against Lille, although the encounter could still come too soon for Díaz.

title: Lazio ultras temporarily lift Stadio Olimpico boycott but not everybody agrees
summary: ROME, ITALY - AUGUST 16: SS Lazio and Mantova 1911 remembered Livio Berruti with a minute's silence prior the Coppa Italia match between SS Lazio and Mantova 1911 at Stadio Olimpico on August 16, 2026 in Rome,
content:

(Photo by Marco Rosi - SS Lazio/Getty Images) Ultras of Lazio’s Curva Nord have announced that they will temporarily lift their Stadio Olimpico boycott for their Serie A clash at home against Atalanta on December 6, but not all supporters agree with the decision.

Lazio supporters have been boycotting their home matches since the beginning of the calendar year in protest of owner Claudio Lotito.

Fans are demanding that Lotito sell the club and had promised that they would not return to the stadium, aside from derby fixtures, until he had done so.

Despite home season tickets plummeting to around 3,000 season and away supporters regularly outnumbering home fans in the Stadio Olimpico in 2026-27, Lazio have surged to the top of the Serie A table and remain unbeaten after the first 12 league matches of the season.

title: Hannover 96 sideline Källman for remainder of 2026 with muscle problems
summary: Hannover 96 have confirmed that they will have to do without the services of center forward Benjamin Källman for the time being. The 28-year-old suffered a structural muscle injury in his right hamstring during
content:
Hannover 96 have confirmed that they will have to do without the services of center forward Benjamin Källman for the time being.

The 28-year-old suffered a structural muscle injury in his right hamstring during Saturday's 2-1 home win against SpVgg Greuther Fürth.

Whilst reaching top gear, the striker appeared to pull up and clutch his leg, requiring an immediate substitution in the 8th-minute.

Following thorough examinations, it has now been confirmed that the Finnish international will be out for the remainder of the year.

Despite only registering three assists in 12 games in the 2.Bundesliga, the news still comes as a hammer blow to the club.

content:

Across all competitions, Olympique Marseille's number nine has scored nine goals in 15 games this season, along with four assists.

content:

Sęk w tym, że monopol Francuzów na transmitowanie najlepszej ligi świata może wkrótce dobiec końca.

Jak ujawnił Paweł Wilkowicz na łamach portalu WP Sportowe Fakty, właśnie trwa przetarg na prawa do pokazywania ekstraklasowych meczów na lata 2027-31.

Obok legendarnego już wręcz broadcastera w szranki stanął również… Disney+.

I bynajmniej nie jest bez szans.

content:

To się udało i już wkrótce ekipa Hansiego Flicka zawita w Azerbejdżanie.

Zabraknie jednak kluczowego zawodnika, z którym Polak wyjątkowo mocno chciał się zmierzyć.

Mniej więcej przed miesiącem piłkarz Sabah Baku był gościem Kanału Sportowego, w którym wypowiedział się na temat zbliżającego się spotkania z Barceloną.

Przyznał, że szczególnie czeka na pojedynki z prawym skrzydłowym Dumy Katalonii Laminem Yamalem.
